description: Survey aggregates that passed the Curb Cut disclosure gate (packages/ingest/src/curbcut_ingest/disclosure.py).
disclosure_rule: Cells with fewer than 30 unweighted respondents in the denominator are suppressed (primary). Where a partition of cells that add up (breakdown levels, women and men, states within a zone or Nigeria, zones, severity levels) would then hold exactly one suppressed cell, its smallest other cell is suppressed too (secondary), until none does. Suppressed cells have estimate, se, interval, n_unweighted, n_effective and df null and suppressed = true.

mpi2021_state_national.csv.citation: National Bureau of Statistics, Multidimentional Poverty index Survey 2021 v1.0
mpi2021_state_national.csv.design: NOT the WG-SS (verification.md D39, D43): seeing/hearing/walking are yes/no screeners (mpi_screener_*_any); 1-4 items for self-care d11a, cognition d12a, communication = worse of d9a/d10a, upper body = worse of d13a/d14a (*_3plus). Weight pop_wgt/hhsize; strata a1 x a1b x a3 and PSU a4 are assumptions (D40).

p5_ghs_estimates.csv.citation: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS), Nigeria. General Household Survey, Panel 2018-2019, Wave 4 (NGA_2018_GHSP-W4_v03_M) and 2023-2024, Wave 5 (NGA_2023_GHSP-W5_v02_M). World Bank Microdata Library.
p5_ghs_estimates.csv.design: P5 exploratory E1 (pre-registration section 8): people aged 15+ in W4 linked to W5, with no severe difficulty in W4; onset = a severe WG-SS answer in W5. Change-score weighted least squares with the longitudinal weight, EA clusters. Counts are people.
p5_ghs_estimates.csv.disclosure_rule: Model estimates: suppressed (numbers and both group counts null, suppressed = true) if the exposed (or onset) group or the comparison group has fewer than 30 unweighted units. No complementary suppression: estimates are not parts of a published total.
p5_ghs_estimates.csv.source: Nigeria General Household Survey-Panel, Waves 4 (2018-2019) and 5 (2023-2024)
p5_ghs_estimates.csv.terms: World Bank Microdata Library public-use terms: aggregates only, cite the dataset.
